text:
The best candidate is **Gasper**, specifically Elon Gasper, co-founder of the 1980s software company Bright Star Technology and later VP of educational games at Sierra, where he worked on the chess title Power Chess ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elon_Gasper), [Crunchbase](https://www.crunchbase.com/person/elon-gasper)). He doesn't fit the Michigan clue, though: sources put his degrees at Michigan State, not the University of Michigan, and his chess claim is tagged "citation needed." The team note's answer is plausible but not fully verified.

CONFIDENCE: 45
